messages:
Maya Lin: Quick check — we need to start a rolling SLA reservation for a new Dedicated GPU pool in eu-west1 for the payment-models team. Goal: avoid cross-AZ scheduling for latency-sensitive serving. Who owns the vendor lead-time / quota bump conversation?
Oliver Park: I can take vendor convo. Are we talking A100/H100? Also do we need hard AZ pinning or soft affinity?
Maya Lin: Mostly A100s for now, maybe H100 later. Prefer soft affinity (prefer same zone) to keep autoscaler flexible but pin for high-prio tenants during their windows.
Sanjay Rao: GCP reservations only guarantee capacity per zone if you do zonal reservations; regional ones are flexible. For Dedicated we can use zonal reservations + node affinity labels. That increases quota requests per zone though.
Maya Lin: Understood. What's the ETA on per-zone quota increases? Any vendor constraints for reserved racks?
Oliver Park: Reached out to vendor yesterday — short answer: 4–6 weeks for rack procurement if we ask for specific AZs. If we accept regional mix + soft-affinity, we can do a faster handoff (1–2 weeks) using spare standby.
Tia Nguyen: From product side: we want a rollout window next month for canary. Can we target soft-affinity + a canary zonal reservation (small zonal reserve for 1 zone) to ensure latency in the canary region?
Sanjay Rao: That sounds sane. Plan: create a small zonal reservation in eu-west1-b for the canary (8x A100), request regional capacity for the rest, and add node-pool labels like:
```bash
# terraform snippet (zonal reservation)
resource "google_compute_region_instance_group" "eu-west1b_canary" {
  name = "eu-west1b-canary-ig"
  region = "europe-west1"
  zone = "europe-west1-b"
  # ...
}
```
We'll also file quota requests for per-zone GPUs: +8 to eu-west1-b and +40 regional as fallback.
Oliver Park: I'll ping vendor for rack ETA and confirm whether they can preferentially place racks in eu-west1-b. I'll also open the procurement ticket and loop legal for contract amendment (expect 4–6 week timeline if they need dedicated racks).
Maya Lin: Thanks. Tia can you confirm the exact canary dates?
Tia Nguyen: Canary planned week-of May 11. If we want 1 zone reserved start-of-week, we need to have quota + reservation before EOW.
Maya Lin: Got it. Oliver — can you escalate the vendor reply and set expectations? If they can't hit EOW, we fallback to soft-affinity + autoscaler labels.
Oliver Park: Will escalate. Also creating a quick PR for terraform and a runbook. Drafting now.
Maya Lin: Please include a runbook step to failover to regional-mix if a whole AZ degrades. Include alert thresholds for cross-AZ latency > 20ms and token-drop rate.
Sanjay Rao: I'll add the node affinity taint/toleration snippet to the PR so tenants can request preferred zones.
infra-bot: Reminder: file quota increase via internal GCP portal (link: https://console.cloud.google.com/quotas) and attach procurement ticket id when created.
Tia Nguyen: I'll add the canary schedule to the ticket once PR is up.
Maya Lin: Great — next actions: @Oliver escalate vendor + open procurement ticket, @Sanjay prepare Terraform + quota numbers, @Tia confirm canary dates in ticket. I'll check back EOD. :thumbsup:
